notes: εἷς ἕκαστος split as *man* / *every*; the joined reading (*every man* headed on *every*) is named in the unit's note as required by rule 16.
τῇ ἰδίᾳ διαλέκτῳ follows rule 47: ἴδιος carries the supplied *his own* and the article is displaced under rule 20. Contrast v.8, where the expressed ἡμῶν takes the possessive.
